name: Minatsuki Sakuya
source:
"I'm having trouble understanding your behavior."

The student council vice president, he's a gentle and hard-working honor student. He's too serious, preachy, and frequently goes on long lectures. However, he also has an honest side: he praises those who are making an effort and readily admits to his faults. He's wealthy.

He's always being swayed by Niki, the student council president, who he shares a dorm with. He often complains about the ever optimistic Kaito.

Sign: Virgo
Likes: Train, cello
Dislikes: Water (seas and pools)
Power: Water

[Translated from [url=http://dearmagi.caerux.com/character/]official website[/url]]
